purpose: Freeze the scientific argument, source-data mapping, arithmetic checks, privacy boundary and render-time obligations for the main endpoint figure before a plotting backend is selected.

figure_contract.results_level_question: Does admitted benchmark-grounded knowledge improve each frozen endpoint relative to its strong control, and does public-only composition preserve pinned direct-family behavior?
figure_contract.core_conclusion: Across two separately frozen studies, proof-carrying skills improve full-denominator endpoint accuracy through observed corrections with no paired regressions, while the retrospective mixed router preserves all pinned direct-family outputs.

a.claim: Within-study endpoint accuracy increases from 54/140 to 100/140 for TSP and from 828/2845 to 2752/2845 for OR-Debug.
a.prohibited_inference: Do not pool the two endpoints or attach an item-level significance claim to TSP.

b.claim: The frozen cohorts contain 46 and 1924 corrections, respectively, with zero observed paired regressions.
b.prohibited_inference: Zero observed regressions is not a future non-regression guarantee.

c.claim: All seven TSP size strata improve descriptively; 65 of 100 OR-Debug structural groups improve, 35 tie and none decline.
c.prohibited_inference: TSP sizes are descriptive strata with shared template lineage; the structural key does not prove complete source or generation-template lineage.

d.claim: All 2985 routed outputs equal their pinned direct-family outputs, with zero route, output, source or terminal mismatches.
d.prohibited_inference: This retrospective identity audit does not recompute accuracy or establish routing under distribution shift.

render_time_blocking_checks: Select and persist exactly one plotting backend: Python or R.
Render PDF and SVG at 180 mm final width with editable text and a 5 pt glyph floor.
Measure final panel rectangles and pass the 1.5 pt multi-panel alignment gate.
Run plotting-source validation, PDF text audit and final-PDF collision audit.
Inspect every panel and the complete figure at final physical size.
Verify that the zero-regression category remains visibly labelled and that panel d is subordinate and marked accuracy-not-rescored.
Record any alignment exemption for the intentionally asymmetric hero panel.

decision.remaining_blocker: No plotting backend has been selected or persisted; no final figure has been rendered or visually audited.
